title: [LOGGED OUT] The LUDUS logo in the header goes back to Home

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Store page loaded (readyState complete). Cookie banner shown.

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Clicked Dismiss; banner gone after about 2 s.

steps.text: Click the LUDUS logo at the left of the header.
steps.saw: Clicked the logo link; the browser went to https://site.ludus-game.com/.

steps.text: Is the address now https://site.ludus-game.com/ (with or without a final "/")?
Is "Home" shown in yellow in the header?
steps.saw: Home text is yellow (inner span color rgb(249, 223, 66)); the other items are white.
